gap_policy.B1_TREND_PULLBACK_CONTINUATION: current boundary and previous 50 closed M15 bars must be exact contiguous 15-minute observations
gap_policy.B4_OVEREXTENSION_MEAN_REVERSION: current boundary and previous 50 closed M15 bars must be exact contiguous 15-minute observations
gap_policy.Track_A_overlap_reference: current boundary and previous 50 closed M15 bars must be exact contiguous 15-minute observations
gap_policy.B2_COMPRESSION_EXPANSION: current boundary and previous 500 closed M15 bars must be exact contiguous 15-minute observations

rolling_compression_percentile.value: bb_width20_bps computed at the immediately previous fully closed bar
rolling_compression_percentile.rank_window: last 500 fully closed bb_width observations including the current known closed-bar value

feature_formulas.EMA: pandas ewm span with adjust=false evaluated at previous closed bar
feature_formulas.ATR14: simple rolling mean of closed-bar true range over 14 observations
feature_formulas.Bollinger_width20_bps: 4 times population standard deviation of 20 closed closes divided by 20-close mean times 10000
feature_formulas.rolling_breakout: current open strictly above prior closed rolling high or strictly below prior closed rolling low
feature_formulas.current_open_gap_bps: current open divided by previous closed close minus one times 10000
